# Icon

A line icon (Lucide), referenced by name, with a consistent stroke width.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Icons in buttons, list items, menus and empty states; the `icon` field of menu items uses the same names

## Import

```ts
import { Icon } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Referenced by name; the color follows the text color.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={3}>
      <Icon name="folder" />
      <Icon name="messages" />
      <Icon name="users" size={20} />
      <Icon name="alert" label="Warning" />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `IconName` | Icon name, see `iconNames` (only registered icons can be used). | — | Yes |
| `size` | `number` | Size in pixels, 16 by default. | — | No |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Stroke width, 1.75 by default (thin but crisp). | — | No |
| `tone` | `'inherit' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'accent' \| 'danger' \| 'success' \| 'warning'` | Color: `inherit` follows the text color (default); the others are semantic colors. State colors such as hover and selected are controlled by the surrounding element. | `'inherit'` | No |
| `label` | `string` | Text label for meaningful icons; omit it for purely decorative icons (hidden from screen readers). | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
